newsitem.title: USA: U.S. has world's 13th lowest sugar production cost.
newsitem.headline: U.S. has world's 13th lowest sugar production cost.

text.p: The United States ranks 13th lowest in production costs among the 110 nations that produce sugar and corn sweeteners, according to a data presented Tuesday to the American Sugar Alliance.

The study by LMC International placed U.S. sugar as the 13th lowest of 110 nations during a six-year period. Beet sugar growers were second lowest of 38 nations, cane sugar was 27th lowest out of 62 nations and corn fructose was lowest among 15 nations.

LMC kept cost of production figures for most nations confidential and declined to provide overall country rankings in most cases. A spokesman said Chile outranked the United States in beet sugar costs in the period ending in the 1994/95 crop year, although the United States was lowest cost for the final three years.
U.S. sugar and corn sweeteners ranked 15th in the world in the previous LMC study period.
The material was presented at the annual meeting of the American Sugar Alliance, held this year in Montana.
ASA officials said it was impressive that the U.S. ranking improved during a period when the average world cost of producton declined.
